'''Galaxy Noodles''' was a noodle shop located in [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Lower Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was owned by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Lauli Wahlo/Legends|Lauli Wahlo]].
